frasi.Prese, relè, interruttori multicanale, p: SONOFF / eWeLink compatible plugs, relays, multi-channel switches, energy-metering plugs, TH thermostats, dimmers and bulbs are controlled directly on the local network: instant response, and the state arrives even when you press the physical button. The eWeLink cloud is needed at most once, to download the devicekeys.
frasi.Abbina i dispositivi con l'app eWeLink,: Pair the devices with the eWeLink app, update the firmware (3.5.0 or later) and keep LAN mode on. Server and devices must be on the same network, without isolation between Wi-Fi clients.
frasi.Nella card premi Cerca in rete: compaion: In the card press Search the network: all devices that are on appear. Those in DIY mode (BASICR3, MINIR2, MINIR3, D1, B02/B05-BL; not MINIR4, MINIR4M and BASICR4) are added right away with Add.
frasi.Gli altri sono cifrati e chiedono la dev: The others are encrypted and need the devicekey. The easiest way: create an application on dev.ewelink.cc (Personal Developer is free), set the address shown in the card as Redirect URL, enter APP ID and APP SECRET in the eWeLink account section and press Sign in with eWeLink. Names and devicekeys arrive on their own.
frasi.Senza cloud: tieni premuto il tasto del: Without the cloud: hold the device button for 5 seconds, connect to the ITEAD-10000 Wi-Fi (password 12345678), open http://10.10.7.1/device and copy deviceid and apikey (it is the devicekey) into the manual entry; then complete the pairing with the app.
frasi.Dopo il primo scarico il cloud non serve: After the first download the cloud is no longer needed: everything works on the local network. Tip: an eWeLink account dedicated to the server, with the devices shared from the main account.
frasi.I dispositivi compaiono tra i dispositiv: The devices appear among the dashboard devices: drag them into the rooms. Metering plugs show power, voltage, current and energy.
frasi.Se un dispositivo non compare nella rice: If a device does not show up in the search: check that it is on and on the same network (VLANs, guest Wi-Fi and Docker without host networking block the announcements), or enter its IP address by hand. Cloud-only devices (DW2 door sensors, L1, KING-M4, POW R1) work through the eWeLink cloud with the account connected: their state arrives in real time. Compatible with SONOFF / eWeLink devices: trademarks of their respective owners.
